provenance.origin: Authored by script in Blender from the owner-approved Vigil look (issue #38) and the #140 gate-1 decisions; textures are r001 swatches (project-owned) or procedural; no third-party or downloaded content

recipe.method: Architecture pieces that block any of 72 candidate camera positions (3 distances x pitches 35/45/60 x 8 yaws) to any floor cell, or rise near the board, exported as a separate mesh for dither fade; conforming subdivision (no T-junctions); r002: the stained-glass rose (about 9 m across) is re-pointed from a 128 x 128 atlas region (14.2 texels/m) to a new 2000 x 2000 region at atlas pixel (2072, 24) with 24 px of wrapped padding, the same design redrawn at full resolution (222.2 texels/m); the atlas becomes 4096 x 2048 with the old 2048 square pixel for pixel in the left half, so every non-rose vertex keeps its texel (its U is rescaled by 1/2); no position, normal, vertex colour or index changes (patch_rose_vigil.py, proved by validate_rose_vigil.py)

parameters.units: metres, 1 cell = 1.50 m, footprint 18 x 12 cells = 27 x 18 m centred on the origin
parameters.material: one baseColor atlas 4096x2048 plus COLOR_0 RGBA (A = glow mask)
parameters.sampling: Linear (trilinear + mips) with 16 px wrapped padding per atlas region
parameters.pivot: origin = board centre at floor level; place at identity together with SM_World_Vigil
parameters.atlas: the r001 2048x2048 atlas unchanged in the left half (pixel for pixel; non-rose U coordinates rescaled by 1/2 to keep their texels) plus a 2000 x 2000 rose region at atlas pixel (2072, 24) with 24 px wrapped padding in the right half; SM_World_Vigil keeps its own 2048 atlas, which has no rose

lods.tool: Blender collapse decimator, UV-island seams kept, 16-bit COLOR_0 unchanged, the atlas embedded as the r002 export (4096 x 2048), extreme vertices pinned

settings.importer: Interchange glTF via Content/Python/import_dark_fantasy_theme.py, explicit reviewed reimport (#145 phase 2)
settings.material: MI_* child of M_DiceRollTheme: texture x COLOR_0.rgb, glow from COLOR_0.a
settings.texture_filter: trilinear with anisotropic 8, mips generated, never nearest
settings.texture_compression: default (sRGB, mips); no nearest or editor-icon compression
settings.lods: explicit LOD1 (about 50 %) and LOD2 (about 25 %, up to 40 % where the silhouette needs it) imported from <name>_LOD1.glb and <name>_LOD2.glb beside the LOD0 export
settings.collision: none (presentation only; blocking comes from gameplay data)
settings.vertex_colour: COLOR_0 VEC4 normalised uint16 (RGB light, A glow mask)
settings.axes: metres, +X forward, Z up (glTF Y-up export)
